advancement.legendary_spellbooks.annihil: If You Gaze Into the Abyss...
advancement.legendary_spellbooks.title: Legendary Spellbooks
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.annihi: %1$s was obliterated by a resonant annihilation blast from %2$s
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_: %1$s was engulfed and crushed by %2$s's clouds
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.flame_: %1$s was consumed by the subterranean flames summoned by %2$s
spell.legendary_spellbooks.ambush_thorns: Imbue yourself with thorns, acting as the Thorns enchantment to damage attackers.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.annihilation_: Channel a devastating beam of energy. While firing, you are locked in place. If aimed near the ground, the beam scatters small energy orbs on impact.
Launch a concentrated bomb of destructive energy that explodes on impact, dealing damage and scattering small energy orbs around the area.
Create a gravitational well that pulls in nearby creatures. Upon completion, a colossal geyser of energy erupts, dealing massive damage.
Imbue yourself with an unstable frequency, reducing your defense and attack by 25%. For the duration, landing a critical hit triggers a powerful explosion at the target's location.
Stomp the ground to release a fan-shaped shockwave of green fire. The waves deal damage based on the target's maximum health.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_rail.gu: Conjure a line of magical clouds in the direction you are looking. These clouds fall and deal area damage upon impact.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_ring.gu: Conjure multiple rings of magical clouds centered on your position. These clouds fall and deal area damage upon impact.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.collapsed_kin: Summons the spectral knights of the Collapsed Kingdom, bound by ancient duty to arise from the ashes and strike down your foes.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cumulo_charge: Summon a phantom of the 'Cumulonimbus' to charge forward. If locked on, the phantom will pursue its target.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.energy_beam.g: Ascend into the air to unleash a high-output laser. The energy consumption leaves the caster stunned for a short duration after the beam ends.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.flame_eater.g: Target multiple creatures to erupt bursts of fire at their feet. This spell fails if targets are too high above the ground.
Emit a radial burst of fire in equally spaced directions. The flames travel along the ground.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.flameborn_dri: Dash forward wrapped in green fire. Upon colliding with a creature, you stop and deal area damage.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.fossilized_fu: Conjure a pack of skeletal raptors to hunt and shred your foes. Higher spell power increases the number of raptors summoned.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.glacier_erupt: Conjure a line of ice wedges in front of you, freezing any creatures they strike.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.glacier_ringb: Conjure multiple expanding rings of ice centered on your position, freezing nearby creatures.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.hematite_tris: Hurls a large red trident that explodes and scatters multiple explosions around the impact area upon hitting the ground.
Summon a row of thunderclouds in front of you that continuously strike lightning beneath them.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.overgrown_sho: Slam the ground to unleash a burst of toxic spores, poisoning nearby creatures in a wide area.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.possessed_sou: Conjure multiple expanding rings of spectral blades from the ground centered on your position. The color of the blades changes based on the spell level.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.possessed_win: Manifest red wings for a short duration, allowing Elytra flight and increasing your movement speed, jump height, and step height. While active, your attacks inflict the Soul Fracture debuff on targets.
Unleash multiple tornadoes in a radial burst, pulling in and immobilizing creatures in their path.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.release_riftw: Manifest an Annihilation Pursuer, a relentless hunter that tracks its target through dimensional rifts until they are destroyed.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.sentinel_satu: Summon multiple spectral images of the Dune Sentinel behind you to unleash a massive barrage of bombs, carpet-bombing the target area.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.summon_flameb: Summon knights made of eternal fire to fight for you.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.thunder_fanbu: Unleash a burst of lightning bolts that travel outwards in a fan shape, piercing through creatures in their path.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.tornado.guide: Summon a violent vortex that pulls in nearby creatures and renders them immobile.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.triple_nimbus: Summon three rows of thunderclouds in a fan shape that continuously strike lightning beneath them.
tooltip.legendary_spellbooks.annihilator: Grants a 10% chance to teleport away upon taking damage, effectively neutralizing the threat.
tooltip.legendary_spellbooks.stormbound_: This spellbook calls forth thunder, causing rain to swell into storms.
